#!/bin/sh

REPO_DIR="/global/homes/j/jobirk/repositories/OmniLearnLightning_dev"
OUTPUT_DIR="/pscratch/sd/j/jobirk/omnilearned_output/omnilearn_output"
DATASET_PATH="/pscratch/sd/j/jobirk/omnilearn_datasets/"

PRETRAINED_CKPT=""
FINETUNING_DATASET="jetnet150"

TOKENIZER_CKPT="${REPO_DIR}/assets/kmeans_model_2025-12-17-19-08-10-Dry-Gondola_noAddInfo_8192_codes.pth"  # <-- kinematic features only
DATASET_SIZE="100000"

POS_ENCODING_TYPE="sort_descending_in_masked_subset"
MASKING_FRACTION=0.4

VAL_CHECK=1
PATIENCE=100
MAX_EPOCHS=500

# For finetuning vs from-scratch
# JetNet-specific (important that this is correct in args below): --num_classes=5 --use_pid=n --use_add=n
TRAINING_CFG_ALL_SIZES="--use_wandb y --wandb_project omnilearned --wandb_entity joschka-birk --limit_val_batches=1.0 --val_check_interval=${VAL_CHECK} --dataset=${FINETUNING_DATASET} --dataset_size=${DATASET_SIZE}   --use_pid n --use_add n --num_classes=5 --epoch=$MAX_EPOCHS --outdir=${OUTPUT_DIR} --path=${DATASET_PATH} --shuffle_val_test_indices y --seed_for_initial_shuffling=2 --patience=${PATIENCE} --pos_encoding_type=${POS_ENCODING_TYPE} --masking_fraction=${MASKING_FRACTION} --use_one_cycle y --save_top_k -1"

# Size-specific hyperparams (Python fills these)
TRAINING_CFG_SIZE_SPECIFIC="--num_workers=2 --num_nodes=4 --model_size=micro --lr 0.001 --weight_decay 0.01 --batch_size=256 --wandb_tag=jetnet150-gen-finetuning"

TRAINING_CFG="${TRAINING_CFG_ALL_SIZES} ${TRAINING_CFG_SIZE_SPECIFIC}"

# Final command
srun --gpus-per-node 4 shifter --image=docker:jobirk/omnilearn-lightning:v1.0.3 bash -c "cd $REPO_DIR/scripts/ && source /opt/conda/bin/activate && export PYTHONPATH=${REPO_DIR}:$PYTHONPATH && python3 train_lightning.py $TRAINING_CFG --mode=generator"
